disclaimer: This information is compiled strictly from official MCC (DGHS) and NMC bulletins. Seat matrices and schedules vary each academic year. No admission guarantees or fabricated cut-off predictions are provided.

centralCounselling.authority: Medical Counselling Committee (MCC), Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS)
scope: 15% All India Quota (AIQ) MBBS/BDS seats in Government Medical Colleges across India (excluding J&K where specific rules apply)
100% MBBS seats in all All India Institutes of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) across India
100% MBBS seats in JIPMER Puducherry and Karaikal
100% seats in Central Universities (AMU, BHU, Jamia Millia Islamia, Delhi University - MAMC, LHMC, UCMS)
100% seats in Deemed Universities across India
ESIC Medical Colleges Insured Persons (IP) Quota

rounds.description: Online registration, choice filling, locking, seat allotment, and reporting. Free exit option available.
Fresh registration allowed. Candidates who joined in Round 1 can upgrade. Forfeiture of security deposit if allotted and not joined.
Exclusively for candidates without an allotted/admitted seat in Round 1 or 2. Strict rules to prevent seat blocking.
Conducted online by MCC to fill any residual vacant seats strictly in order of merit without fresh registration.

stateCounselling.scope: 85% State Quota seats in State Government Medical/Dental Colleges and 100% seats in State Private Medical Colleges.
stateCounselling.domicileRule: State eligibility requires meeting respective state domicile, schooling, and residency criteria.

stateAuthorities.authority: Directorate of Medical Education and Training (UP DGME)
State Common Entrance Test Cell (CET Cell)
NEET UG Medical & Dental Admission/Counseling Board
Directorate of Medical Education and Research (Selection Committee)
Department of Health & Family Welfare (WB BMOH)

mandatoryDocuments: NEET-UG Admit Card issued by NTA
Class 10 Certificate and Mark Sheet (for Date of Birth proof)
Class 12 Certificate and Mark Sheet (showing PCB and English marks)
Valid Government Photo ID Proof (Aadhaar Card / PAN Card / Driving License / Passport)
Passport size photographs (8-10 copies identical to the photograph uploaded in NEET application)
Provisional Seat Allotment Letter generated online from MCC or State portal
Category Certificate (SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS) in prescribed Central/State format if applicable
PwD Disability Certificate issued by designated Disability Assessment Centers if applicable
